job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions (LAFPP) RFP for financial statement audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year contract (fiscal years ending June 30, 2025, 2026 and 2027) with a maximum fee proposal for each fiscal year; the Board may extend beyond the three-year term through two one-year renewals.
job.acceptance: Three years plus two optional one-year renewals, up to five years, suffices. Fiscal-year dates and fee-proposal details are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System RFP for actuarial services, not LAFPP’s RFP for financial statement audit services. Its five-year term does not support the requested three-year term with two optional one-year renewals.
quotes: CITY OF AUSTIN EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM Request for Proposal (RFP)
Actuarial Services for an Actuarial Determined Contribution (ADC) Rate Defined Benefit Plan
The services requested shall be provided for a term of five years beginning January 1, 2026 and ending December 31, 2030.
